## Task

You are investigating Express's built-in query-string-parsing middleware, starting from the factory function exported by lib/middleware/query.js. Identify the real third-party npm package function it delegates URL parsing to, and that function's own real signature.

First give a short (2-4 sentence) explanation.

Then, on its own line, emit a fenced JSON code block containing an ordered array of the fully-qualified symbol names involved (the in-repo seed and the real external dependency it calls) - only symbols actually present in the provided context package may appear, e.g.:

```json
["lib.middleware.query.query", "parseurl.index.parseurl"]
```


## Response format

Respond with a single fenced JSON object and nothing else:
```json
{"reasoning": "<short explanation>", "symbols": ["<fully.qualified.name>", "..."]}
```
`symbols` lists every code symbol that is part of your answer, in order, by exact fully-qualified name.
